title: The Invitation
briefing: One canvas. One exit. Learn the rhythm before the building wakes up.
hint: Draw a route to the canvas, take it, then reach the teal exit.

title: The Night Watch
briefing: The guard walks the same short beat every time. Read the footsteps.
hint: The guard looks north while you cross the center line.

title: A Moment in the Dark
briefing: Camera B sweeps away for a moment. Waiting is part of the plan.
hint: Wait one second, then cross the camera's column while it faces east.

title: Borrowed Darkness
briefing: The hacker has a window. The thief needs to use it.
hint: Hack the terminal and have the thief start moving once the camera goes dark.

title: The Whole Crew
briefing: Three crew members. One ten-second window.
hint: Hack first. Time the decoy's signal to face Guard D away from the thief.

title: Double Exposure
briefing: One canvas is off the main route. Grab both before the lens returns.
hint: Step off the hallway for the first canvas, then return and mark the second pickup.

title: The Quiet Door
briefing: Two gallery wings share a single service door. The night watch stands just above it.
hint: The door is the only crossing. Walk through while the guard faces north.

title: Curtain Call
briefing: Enter from the east. Recover both pieces before the gallery closes.
hint: Wait for the east-facing sweep, then take each piece as you move west.

title: Blind Spot
briefing: Two lenses share one breaker. Give them both a reason to blink.
hint: Panel H shuts down Camera H and Camera I at the same moment.

title: Understudies
briefing: The guard and camera each have a predictable blind beat.
hint: Let Camera J turn east. Signal from the decoy to turn the guard north.

title: Clockwork
briefing: A patrolling guard and a sweeping lens cross the same room.
hint: The guard will follow a signal even while his regular patrol continues on the timeline.

title: Last Look
briefing: One last room: two canvases, two lenses, and a guard who knows the exits.
hint: The first canvas delays the thief. Signal late enough to cover the second pickup.

title: Reverse Entry
briefing: The stacks hide an east entrance. The archive guard has a short route.
hint: Cross the patrol lane when the guard turns back toward the shelves.

title: Stacks After Hours
briefing: A cataloging camera sweeps the central aisle on a regular beat.
hint: Cross the center after the camera turns to the east.

title: The Switchboard
briefing: One breaker covers the east aisle. Give the thief a clean start.
hint: The hacker can reach the panel in half a second. The blackout starts after hacking completes.

title: Catalog Distraction
briefing: An attentive archivist has a clear view of the borrowed folio.
hint: Signal from the west so the archivist faces away from the floor aisle.

title: Two Ledgers
briefing: The records were split. Both ledgers must leave together.
hint: Take each ledger as you pass. A single breaker shuts the camera down long enough.

title: Telltale Beam
briefing: The upper aisle is exposed to a lens pointing up from the stacks.
hint: The upward sweep lasts two seconds. Cross its column after it turns right.

title: Subfloor Wiring
briefing: The hacker slips below the shelves while the thief takes the upper aisle.
hint: The terminal below disables the upward-facing camera.

title: Cover Story
briefing: The security guard watches the upper aisle from the records desk.
hint: Signal from below the desk. The guard looks down for three seconds.

title: Copy Room
briefing: Two red lenses cover the return route; one breaker feeds both.
hint: Both cameras go dark together. Watch the disabled indicators on the timeline.

title: Loose Index
briefing: A beam and a watchful archivist share the upper aisle.
hint: The hacker handles the beam. The decoy turns the archivist toward the lower floor.

title: Redacted Files
briefing: A sweeping camera and a patrolling guard complicate the return aisle.
hint: The camera turns east while the archivist follows the west-side distraction.

title: Midnight Inventory
briefing: The stolen index has two halves, and all three crew members have a job.
hint: Collect the early file, then let the decoy cover the later crossing.

title: Rooftop Valet
briefing: Slip past the empty valet desk and leave with two sparkling pieces.
hint: Both jewels require a TAKE action. The getaway door is at the far right.

title: Glass Elevator
briefing: A lens above the elevator divides the hall in two.
hint: The camera turns toward the east side after two seconds.

title: Service Console
briefing: The gallery feed runs through a discreet service console.
hint: Have the hacker take one step to the console, then the thief can cross.

title: The Guest List
briefing: The doorman remembers faces. Give him a different one.
hint: The decoy can signal from the upper right and turn the doorman east.

title: Bedroom Detour
briefing: One jewel is off the main route; the other sits across the camera's sightline.
hint: Step up for the first jewel, return to the hall, then take the second.

title: Silent Balcony
briefing: The upstairs hall is watched from below by a rotating lens.
hint: Hold for one second, then cross while the lens points east.

title: Indoor Pool
briefing: A guard watches the upstairs hall from the poolside.
hint: A signal beside the pool turns the guard away from the upper walkway.

title: House Network
briefing: One house panel controls two watchful cameras.
hint: Both feeds share the same shutdown window. Start your thief after the hack.

title: Dinner Bell
briefing: Two pieces are out for display. Security expects the guests to stay put.
hint: A later signal keeps the guard occupied during the second pickup.

title: Private Collection
briefing: Guard, camera, and crew converge on the upper hallway.
hint: The hack blocks the lens. The poolside signal redirects the guard.

title: The Switch
briefing: Enter from the service lift while the household gathers on the other side.
hint: The west-side decoy faces the guard away from the reverse exit route.

title: Penthouse Exit
briefing: A double pickup and a room detour put every second under pressure.
hint: Time the decoy later; the detour delays the thief's crossing.

title: Intake Bay
briefing: The freight entrance offers a direct lane, with one predictable patrol.
hint: The guard turns north as you cross the center of the intake lane.

title: Pressure Line
briefing: A vault camera surveys the access corridor, then checks its side wall.
hint: Wait for the eastward camera sweep before crossing its vertical sightline.

title: Control Room
briefing: The vault cameras answer to a guarded control terminal below the hallway.
hint: Hack at the near panel, then follow the camera's inactive indicator.

title: False Delivery
briefing: A guard expects a courier. The decoy can oblige.
hint: The signal comes from above and right of the guard, redirecting his attention.

title: Redundancy
briefing: Two cameras protect the strong room, both wired to one accessible panel.
hint: Watch both disabled indicators after the hacker finishes.

title: Side Drawer
briefing: One deposit is above the hall; the other is at the end of it.
hint: The upper drawer costs a detour. Keep the camera off for the later crossing.

title: Motion Study
briefing: The upper corridor is watched from below by a guard and rotating camera.
hint: The lens turns east as the decoy draws the guard toward the south.

title: Access Chain
briefing: A single shutdown window has to cover two linked lenses and a timed pickup.
hint: The camera stays dark long enough for both valuables when the thief starts after the hack.

title: Second Window
briefing: Enter from the opposite hall. The crew's jobs stay the same, but the angle changes.
hint: The hacker uses the east console while the west decoy turns the guard away.

title: Long Way Round
briefing: Two deposits sit on different rows. Security meets in the middle.
hint: The first drawer takes time. Delay the decoy signal to cover the second crossing.

title: Last Safe
briefing: Three valuables require a route through both rows of the strong room.
hint: Plan the upper drawer, lower deposit, and final upper safe in that order.

title: Zero Hour
briefing: The vault finale: three pickups, two cameras, one redirected guard, and one exit.
hint: Signal from the west shortly before the middle pickup; the guard must look away from the final safe.
